description: An advanced matrix visual for Power BI, with writeback Power BI only reads. The moment someone has to enter a budget, a forecast or a corrected master data value, the numbers leave the report for Excel and come back days later. And once you need a calculated row that is not in the model, a comment on a cell or a graph inside the grid, the standard matrix stops where your requirement starts. accoPLANNINGV2 covers both. It is a flexible cross table visual that reports on your existing Power BI model and writes data straight back to your own SQL database. This newest generation carries the full writeback engine from our Professional version and adds AI assistance, extended calculation and formatting capabilities, rich commentary, line item detail and drag and drop analysis. Finance and business teams use it for budgets, rolling forecasts and project plans. Data owners maintain dimensions and hierarchies themselves instead of raising a ticket to IT, and every change is stored with a full audit trail in your own database. Beyond the standard matrix — works on your existing model, with or without writeback Calculated rows and columns, spreads, allocations, ratios and variance logic, without changing the model Conditional formatting down to cell level, plus in-cell bars, variance indicators and trend graphics Custom views, drag and drop dimensions, line item detail and rich…
